Higher Precision is proud to represent Mitutoyo and offer all Mitutoyo Hardness Testers for online purchase. If there is a specific Hardness Tester that you are unable to locate, please contact our inside sales department and we are happy to assist you.
Mitutoyo is known for many different types of precision measurement tools and hardness testers is another area where they are one of the most requested brands.  Higher Precision can assist you to find the perfect hardness tester for your company no matter what scales you need to measure in.  We carry hardness testers from your basic Rockwell scales of A, B and C to Vickers, Brinell, loupe and more.
